request.prompt: Cool, sly noir jazz-funk for sneaking through a small upscale jewelry shop at night. 96 BPM, D minor, 4/4, steady tempo throughout. Brushed jazz drums with a light ghost-note swing, a walking-but-funky upright bass ostinato, soft Rhodes chords, a vibraphone adding glassy sparkle, and a muted trumpet playing a short sly five-note minor blues motif with space between phrases. Restrained and confident, like a professional who knows exactly what they're doing. Structure: 8-bar A section, 8-bar variation of A, 8-bar B section with a slightly higher, more curious melody, then back to the top. No intro, no ending, no fade: it must loop seamlessly. Instrumental only, no vocals. No electronic beats, no synths, no four-on-the-floor kick.
